item.title: “We just ask to be seen as individuals”: Nepalis in Denmark speak out
item.description: Community members and Nepal’s ambassador respond to media scrutiny, calling for nuance in debates about migration, work, and integration.

item.title: Fake messages may steal MitID info from MobilePay users
item.description: A wave of fraudulent SMS and emails urge Danes to link their MobilePay to MitID. These scams threaten users’ personal information. The messages falsely claim verification is required to meet PSD2 regulations by January 27, 2026, warning of temporary transaction blocks post-deadline. item.title: German media tried to raise US flag in Nuuk
item.description: A German comedian, Maxi Schafroth, employed by NDR, attempted to raise the American flag in Nuuk, Greenland, for the satire show “Extra 3.” NDR stated that it was meant as a joke, and Schafroth received a fine. item.title: S most popular among students, biggest in school poll
item.description: Socialdemokratiet is the largest party in Denmark according to the 2026 school election for students in grades 8-10, receiving 23.03% of votes. Approximately 70,000 students participated, and the results were broadcasted online. In the previous 2024 school election, Liberal Alliance was the largest party but this year it became second with 16.37% of the votes. […]

item.title: Embassy: Danish flags honoring soldiers allowed to stay
item.description: The U.S. Embassy in Denmark allows Danish flags to remain in front of the embassy, expressing respect for Danish veterans and their sacrifices. Previously, the embassy had removed 44 Danish flags erected to honor fallen Danish soldiers. This action followed President Donald Trump’s comments about NATO soldiers in Afghanistan, which upset Danish veterans, leading them […]

item.title: Danish defense firm makes drone camera deal in Lithuania
item.description: Danish company UXV Technologies, which specializes in defense technological solutions, has partnered with Lithuanian Aktyvus Photonics. This collaboration will see UXV integrate Aktyvus Photonics’ laser technology directly into UXV’s cameras used in drones and unmanned vehicles. item.title: Microsoft loses billions in biggest stock drop in 6 years
item.description: On Thursday, Microsoft experienced its largest stock market decline in the USA in six years, with a ten percent drop, reducing its market value by $388 billion. item.title: Series of iPhones boosts Apple’s sales to new heights
item.description: Apple’s sales exceeded expectations in the first quarter, reaching a record $143.8 billion, a 16% increase from the same quarter last year. iPhone sales climbed 23% year-over-year to $85.3 billion, surpassing analysts’ predictions of $78.3 billion. item.title: Royal couple played ball at Eastern Europe’s first NBA school
item.description: The Danish royal couple visited Eastern Europe’s first NBA basketball school in Vilnius, Lithuania, where Queen Mary successfully made a basketball shot. item.title: Board wants to keep teacher training in Frederiksberg
item.description: The board of Københavns Professionshøjskole has decided to keep the teacher education program at Frederiksberg. This decision comes after the government provided permanent funding for the program at Campus Nyelandsvej, which was facing closure.
